_meta.units: millimetres unless the key says otherwise (CFM, mmH2O, RPM as named)

statusValues.primary: number taken from a manufacturer page/PDF (read directly, or quoted in a search result of the official page)
statusValues.secondary: number from a retailer or review only; manufacturer value not reachable
statusValues.mixed: some fields primary, some secondary; see notes and secondarySources

caveats: Several manufacturer sites (gigabyte.com, nvidia.com sub-pages, amd.com, nzxt support, arctic.de spec tab, Noctua HTML) returned 403/429/truncated pages to the fetcher; where so, numbers came from search-result excerpts of the official page and are flagged in notes.
A null means the number was not found in any source reached; it was NOT estimated.
Orientation convention used for coolers: widthMm = side-to-side across the motherboard, overallDepthMm = front-to-back along the fan axis incl. fans, heightMm = above the CPU socket.

gpus.name: GIGABYTE GeForce RTX 5090 WINDFORCE OC 32G (GV-N5090WF3OC-32GD)
gpus.notes: Gigabyte's size line reads 342 x 150 x 65 mm (L x W x H): W=150 is bracket-to-top height, H=65 is thickness. Official page returned 403 to the fetcher; values come from a search excerpt of the official page and agree with retailers. slots 3.25 is BuildCores (CCL says 3.3; Paradigit says 3.5) = secondary. fanCount 3 is secondary (retailers). fanSizeMm and flowThrough not stated anywhere reached -> null. | Follow-up research: fan size still not found. Gigabyte marketing mentions an extended heatsink air passes through (Screen cooling), which hints at a shortened PCB, but no measured PCB length was found, so flowThrough stays null. Thickness 65 vs 70 mm conflicts between listings (secondary).

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 Founders Edition
gpus.notes: Length 304, height 137 (NVIDIA labels it 'Width') and 2-slot are from NVIDIA's page, which also markets 'Double Flow Through' design (flowThrough=true). The same page's installation text mentions 3-slot (61 mm) clearance, which looks like template text shared with 40-series FE pages; not reconciled. thicknessMm 40 and fanCount 2 are secondary (Tom's Hardware / overclock.net); a Japanese Gizmodo review quotes 50 mm. Fan diameter not found -> null. | Follow-up research: LANOC measured both fans 115 mm edge to edge, 304 x 40 mm, double flow-through (secondary); thickness 40 confirmed.

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER Founders Edition
gpus.notes: NVIDIA page: 304 mm, 'Width' 137 mm (= card height), 3-slot, 61 mm. Fan count 2, fan ~115 mm ring-to-ring (118 mm opening) and the pass-through design are secondary (LANOC, HotHardware). Reviewer-measured sizes vary slightly (LANOC 310 x 140 x 61). | Follow-up research: LANOC: 118 mm opening / 115 mm ring-to-ring (SUPER); the original 4080 FE was quoted at 110 mm.

gpus.name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Founders Edition
gpus.notes: NVIDIA page: 304 mm, 'Width' 137 mm (= height), 3-slot (61 mm). Two fans (one pushes across the PCB, one pulls through the fin stack at the PCB-free end) and ~115 mm size are from reviewers (Guru3D, LANOC, Tom's Hardware: 305x136x61 measured). One spec listing says 'triple fan' - judged an error. NVIDIA's own page gives no fan count.

gpus.name: AMD Radeon RX 7900 XTX (AMD reference)
gpus.notes: AMD lists length 287 mm and 2.5 slots (primary). heightMm 123 and thicknessMm 51.5 are secondary (Tom's Hardware 287 x 123 x 51.5; Igor's Lab measured ~115 mm height from slot edge). Fan count/size and flow-through not stated in any source reached -> null. | Follow-up research: LANOC measured (secondary): 3 fans, 84 mm blade (87 mm opening), 50 mm thick, PCB runs the full card length (flowThrough=false). fanCount, fanSizeMm, flowThrough and thickness are secondary; thickness 50 (LANOC) vs 51.5 (Tom's Hardware).

gpus.name: ASUS Dual GeForce RTX 4060 OC Edition 8GB (DUAL-RTX4060-O8G)
gpus.notes: ASUS spec page (fetched): 227.2 x 123.24 x 49.6 mm, 2.5 slot (ASUS labels the 123.24 as width = bracket-to-top height). Two Axial-tech fans per retailers (secondary). Fan diameter not found -> null; flowThrough not stated -> null. The DUAL-RTX4060-O8G-V2 is a different, smaller card (202.2 x 120.3 x 40.1, 2-slot) - do not mix. | Follow-up research: fan size conflicts: Tom's 89, LANOC measured 90, Guru3D 95; 90 used (secondary). flowThrough left null: LANOC says the PCB ends short and one fan can partially blow through the heatsink, i.e. partial.

airCoolers.name: Noctua NH-U12A
airCoolers.notes: Noctua infosheet (read directly): heatsink 158 x 125 x 58 mm, with 2x NF-A12x25 PWM 158 x 125 x 112 mm; fans 120x120x25. Noctua's width (125) includes fan clips. 7 heatpipes. No RAM clearance figure on the infosheet -> null. | Follow-up research: Noctua FAQ (read via search summary) says 100% RAM compatibility, i.e. no overhang over RAM slots on AM4/AM5/LGA115x, so no numeric limit exists; on LGA2066 RAM must be <=42 mm. ramClearanceMm stays null. https://www.noctua.at/en/support/faqs/what-is-the-ram-clearance-of-my-noctua-cpu-cooler

airCoolers.name: Noctua NH-D15 (original, not G2)
airCoolers.notes: Noctua infosheet (read directly): heatsink 165 x 150 x 135 mm, with 2x NF-A15 PWM 165 x 150 x 161 mm; NF-A15 is 140x150x25 (fits 120 mm hole pattern). ramClearanceMm 64 = single-fan mode (front fan fitted); in dual-fan mode only standard RAM up to 32 mm fits unless the front fan is raised in cases with >165 mm cooler clearance (which raises total height). A search excerpt of Noctua's HTML page quoted 168/160 mm heights, which conflicts with the infosheet; infosheet used.

airCoolers.name: DeepCool AK620
airCoolers.notes: DeepCool page (fetched): product 129x138x160 (L x W x H), heatsink 127x110x157, fan 120x120x25, 6x 6 mm heatpipes. DeepCool's L/W/H axis meaning is not defined on the page; mapping 138 = front-to-back with front fan and 129 = side-to-side is my inference from heatsink 110 + 25 mm fan + clips = ~138. ramClearanceMm 43 is with both fans; 59 mm in single-fan config. AK620 DIGITAL is 162 mm tall. | Follow-up research: a review (funkykit) labels the dimensions L129 x W138 x H160, consistent with my mapping; DeepCool's manual not checked.

airCoolers.name: Thermalright Peerless Assassin 120 SE
airCoolers.notes: Thermalright page (fetched): heatsink L125 x W110 x H155, fan TL-C12C 120x120x25, dual-tower category. overallDepthMm 135 is secondary (Digitec; another retailer says 138). Fan count 2 is secondary (retailer listings; page didn't state). Page gives no RAM clearance number ('leave clearance for tall memory'), so null. The newer V3 variant uses different fans (TL-P12) and weight. | Follow-up research: fan count 2 now confirmed by the manufacturer manual parts list (B Fan x2). Official overall depth and RAM clearance still not published (forum RAM figures 35-42 mm, unverified).

airCoolers.name: Cooler Master Hyper 212 Black Edition
airCoolers.notes: Cooler Master page (fetched) lists 123 x 77 x 158.8 mm (L x W x H) without saying what it covers, and a 120x120x25 fan; 4 heatpipes, so single tower. 123 mapped to side-to-side and 77 to heatsink depth is inference. overallDepthMm (with fan), fanCount and ramClearanceMm not stated on the page -> null (the product is believed to ship with one fan but that is not sourced here; verify before using). | Follow-up research: fanCount 1 is secondary (Overclockers listing for the R2). Axis mapping and overall depth still unsourced.

aios.name: Corsair iCUE H100i RGB PRO XT (240 mm, CW-9060043-WW)
aios.notes: Corsair page (fetched): ML120 PWM x2, 2400 RPM, 75 CFM, 4.2 mmH2O, 240 mm aluminum radiator. Radiator 277 x 120 x 27 mm is secondary (retailers/reviews); Corsair's page gives no radiator dimensions. Fan 120 x 25 mm from Corsair's refurb listing / ML120 fan page. Max values are at full speed. | Follow-up research: one review says 276 mm radiator length; 277 kept.

aios.name: NZXT Kraken 280 (2023, RL-KN280-B1)
aios.notes: Radiator 315 x 143 x 30 and F140P figures (500-1500 RPM, 33.22-99.68 CFM, 0.91-2.75 mmH2O) are from NZXT's support/product pages as quoted in search results (pages themselves returned 403/404 to the fetcher). Fan thickness 26 mm is secondary (Adorama). A Best Buy listing quotes 1800 RPM / 90.76 CFM, judged a data error. Do not confuse with Kraken Plus 280 (321 x 140 x 27) or Kraken Elite 280 (321 x 137 x 27).

aios.name: Arctic Liquid Freezer III 360 (non-Pro, ACFRE00136A)
aios.notes: Radiator 398 x 120 x 38, 3x P12 PWM 200-1800 rpm, 56.30 CFM, 2.20 mmH2O are from Arctic's product page as quoted in a search result (spec tab truncated in the fetcher). Fan thickness 25 mm is NOT on that excerpt: it is the P12 Pro 120x120x25 from OCinside (secondary); P12 standard assumed the same family size - verify. The Pro model is different (600-3000 rpm, 77 CFM, 6.9 mmH2O); the A-RGB variant is 200-2000 rpm, 48.82 CFM, 1.85 mmH2O. Also has a 60 mm VRM fan. | Follow-up research: Arctic spec sheet PDF https://www.arctic.de/media/16/63/19/1708429821/Spec_Sheet_Liquid_Freezer_III_360_Black_EN.pdf confirms 398x120x38, 3x P12 PWM, 200-1800 rpm, 56.30 CFM, 2.20 mmH2O, but gives no fan thickness; 25 mm remains unverified.

aios.name: Corsair iCUE H150i ELITE CAPELLIX XT (360 mm, black CW-9060070-WW)
aios.notes: Corsair page (fetched): 3x AF RGB ELITE PWM 120 mm, 550-2100 RPM, 13.8-65.57 CFM, 0.17-2.68 mmH2O; product length 397 and width 119.6 (units unstated, taken as mm). Radiator thickness 27 mm and fan thickness 25 mm are secondary (LDLC / retailer listings quoting Corsair-style specs). Chosen variant: H150i ELITE CAPELLIX XT (current successor lines are H150i ELITE LCD XT / iCUE LINK H150i).

top.note: from marketing copy, not in the tech-spec table

cases.includedFans: 2 x CORSAIR AirGuide 120 mm (position not stated on page)
cases.notes: Corsair page (fetched); dimensions printed without units, taken as mm (466 H x 453 D x 230 W). Page lists a PSU shroud cover plate only as a separate accessory and gives no shroud/basement height -> null. Radiator thickness not specified.

cases.name: Lian Li O11 Dynamic EVO

side.note: inner placement 83 mm with 120 mm fans top/bottom or 63 mm with 140 mm; outer placement 120 mm (120 mm fans) or 100 mm (140 mm fans)

cases.includedFans: none listed on the page (fans are sold separately / RGB version bundles vary)
cases.notes: Lian Li page (fetched). Retailers/Guru3D disagree on some numbers (top rad 420 mm vs 360 mm; GPU 422/425/426/455.7 mm); Lian Li's page used. Drive cage takes a 60 mm fan. Page mentions no PSU shroud/basement (dual-chamber design; shroud height not sourced) -> null. No front intake position listed (front is glass). | Follow-up research: top max thickness conflicts 87.5 vs 83.5 mm total between sources; PBTech (secondary) matches the side figures.

cases.name: Fractal Design North (Chalk White / mesh side panel, FD-C-NOR1C-03)

front.note: GPU limited to 300 mm with a 360 mm front radiator

cases.includedFans: 2 x Aspect 14 PWM (140 mm), installed at the front
cases.notes: Fractal page (fetched) for the mesh-panel variant: 145 mm cooler height is with the fan bracket fitted; a retailer (secondary) says 170 mm without it and for the glass variant. Page lists dimensions L x W x H 447 x 215 x 469 and no PSU shroud/basement information -> null. Top rad 120/240 as listed; dedicated side-panel fan mounts exist for the mesh panel. | Follow-up research: a GamersNexus remark of 36 mm between shroud and fan bracket may refer to this case; unverified, shroud height stays null.

cases.name: Fractal Design Meshify 2 Compact

front.note: retailer/Guru3D: GPU up to 360 mm with no front fan; max radiator width 145 mm

top.note: retailer: 40 mm component-height limit under a top radiator

bottom.note: retailer: only if HDD cage removed

cases.includedFans: Dynamic X2 GP-12 120 mm fans; exact count unclear: Fractal page names GP-12 for front and rear without a count; Guru3D says 3 pre-installed; a search excerpt of Fractal's page said 1 x 120 mm and 2 x 140 mm
cases.notes: Fractal page (fetched): 424 x 210 x 475 (L x W x H), 39.4 L, GPU 341, cooler 169, full-length PSU shroud hiding the drive cage (height not given -> null). PSU 200 mm (retailer: 165 mm with HDD cage + front fan). Included fan count is conflicting between sources; treat as unverified. Rad thickness not listed anywhere reached. | Follow-up research: included fans conflict: Fractal page lists Dynamic X2 GP-12 (front, no count) + 1x GP-12 rear; Custom PC says 2x 140 mm GP-14 front + 1x 120 mm GP-12 rear (secondary). Possibly a newer revision. A 60 mm radiator fits the front with one fan row (Custom PC, secondary).
